<div class="card-body">
'''MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＭＳＥ－６ “マウス” ドロイド</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウーティーニー・エフェクトの対象となっている任意のキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターの代わりに“マウス”ドロイドを移動させて、ウーティーニー・エフェクトを持ち帰ったり、同じ場所に移動して、キャンセルしたりすることができる。移動速度＝３。ウーティーニー・エフェクトを運んだ後、“マウス”ドロイドは手札に戻る。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">外見から、マウスと呼ばれている。各種命令や重要書類を届けるのが役目。収納式のマニピュレータ内蔵。レバックサン・コルムーニ製。気が小さく、臆病なドロイド。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any character targeted by an Utinni Effect. Instead of the character, move the 'mouse' droid to bring back the Utinni Effect, or move it to the same place to cancel it. Landspeed = 3. After carrying the Utinni Effect, the 'mouse' droid returns to your hand.

'''Lore:''' Called 'mouse' because of its appearance. Its job is to deliver various orders and important documents. Contains retractable manipulators. Made by Rebaxan Colmuni. A timid, cowardly droid.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes bringing back the Utinni Effect or moving to the same place to cancel it. The English says to bring it back to be fulfilled or canceled. The Japanese lore calls the droid timid and cowardly; the English describes it as easily frightened.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="psa">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141635870/WwdFZ9K4K0WdzLcyXVyTmw.jpg MSE-6 photograph].</ref>
